phoneNumber.description: The phone number to add to the DNC list. Must be in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890).

source.description: The source or origin of the DNC entry. This helps track where the request originated from.

reason.description: Optional reason for adding the phone number to the DNC list. This can help with compliance documentation.
reason.example: Customer requested to be removed from all marketing calls
